scope: SELECT activeSource on one linked plugin-backed Sound; not all source-selection mechanisms or hosts
availability_reason: The documented activeSource SELECT accessor is not executable in the observed Console build; file-backed selection uses the separate Gateway derivation

definition_source.description: Returns the active source associated to a sound object.

alternatives: The closed active-source output supports file-backed Sound selection by a unique full original-path match in one explicit platform/language view; bounded child and exact-ID reads remain discovery, not proof of active selection.
